LAVA_API_KEY.description: Lava API key (lava.top > Settings > API > API keys). Used for POST /api/v3/invoice and GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

LAVA_WEBHOOK_KEY.description: Webhook API key YOU generate (any random string, max 80 chars) and paste into the Lava product's webhook settings. Lava sends it as the X-Api-Key header on every webhook.

LAVA_OFFER_ID.description: UUID of the Lava offer with dynamic pricing ('Price on request via API'). The Worker charges the converted SellAuth invoice amount on this offer.

SELLAUTH_API_KEY.description: SellAuth API key from [Account > Developers](https://dash.sellauth.com/api). Scope it to your shop.

SELLAUTH_SHOP_ID.description: Your numeric SellAuth shop ID (the number in API URLs like `/shops/1/`).

SELLAUTH_SHOP_URL.description: Your storefront URL, e.g. `https://yourshop.mysellauth.com`. Buyers are returned to `<url>/checkout/<ref>`.

LAVA_BASE_URL.description: Lava API base. Leave the default `https://gate.lava.top`.

SELLAUTH_BASE_URL.description: SellAuth API base. Leave the default `https://api.sellauth.com/v1`.
